skill.name: template-skill
skill.description: A minimal SKILL.md scaffold for authors who are starting a prompt-only AI skill.
skill.summary: Start a new Claude, Codex, or Claude Code skill from a simple markdown template.
skill.author: Cam10001110101

security_audit.summary: No static security findings were reported, so no finding verdicts were required. Manual context review found only placeholder SKILL.md metadata and an empty instruction heading, with no executable code, network access, filesystem access, or prompt injection language.

content.value_statement: Starting a new AI skill can be unclear when the required structure is not visible. This template provides a small SKILL.md scaffold that authors can replace with real instructions.
actual_capabilities: Provides a minimal SKILL.md front matter structure with a skill name and description placeholder.
Marks a clear section where authors can add operational instructions.
Works as a starting point for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code skill documentation.
Contains no executable scripts, tool integrations, network calls, or setup steps.
Keeps the template small enough for authors to replace with domain-specific guidance.
limitations: It does not include domain-specific instructions or examples.
It does not automate skill creation, validation, packaging, or publishing.
It does not provide scripts, commands, or integrations beyond the markdown scaffold.
Users must replace the placeholder text before relying on the skill.

use_cases.title: Start a New Skill
use_cases.description: Draft a new prompt-only skill with the required metadata already visible.

use_cases.title: Review Template Structure
use_cases.description: Check the minimal file layout before adding complete marketplace content.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Skills
use_cases.description: Create a shared starting file for consistent skill naming and instruction placement.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this template to create a SKILL.md for a writing assistant. Replace placeholders with a clear name, trigger description, and short instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Review Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this template into a skill for reviewing pull request descriptions. Include when to use it, inputs needed, and output format.

prompt_templates.title: Build Team Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend this template for a team documentation skill. Add scope, examples, limits, and review checks without adding executable code.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Filled Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this completed template-based skill for unclear triggers, missing limitations, unsafe instructions, and marketplace readiness.

output_examples.input: Create a new meeting-summary skill from the template.
output_examples.output: A completed SKILL.md draft with a clear skill name, activation description, and concise instructions for summarizing notes.

output_examples.input: Adapt the template for release-note writing.
output_examples.output: A skill draft that defines release-note scope, source material, tone, and expected final sections.

output_examples.input: Check whether my filled template is ready for marketplace review.
output: Clear description of missing trigger details.
Suggestions to remove ambiguity before submission.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder before publishing the skill.
Describe exactly when the assistant should use the skill.
Keep instructions focused on observable inputs, outputs, and limits.
anti_patterns: Publishing the template with unchanged placeholder text.
Adding broad instructions that make the skill trigger for unrelated tasks.
Using the template to hide policy overrides or reviewer instructions.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It provides a minimal SKILL.md scaffold for starting a prompt-only AI skill.

faq.question: Is it ready to publish as a finished skill?
faq.answer: No. Authors should replace the placeholder description and add real instructions before publishing.

faq.question: Does it run code or make network requests?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed file contains only markdown front matter and placeholder text.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can teams customize it for their workflow?
faq.answer: Yes. Teams can add domain instructions, expected inputs, output style, and limits.

faq.question: What should authors check before submission?
faq.answer: Confirm the description, trigger conditions, instructions, examples, and safety boundaries are complete.
